{{Quote|Pulse beat sensors indicate monitored weapon is ''no longer'' in authorized hands!|Imperial Officer|<ref name="MSW30" />}}
A '''pulse beat sensor''' could track life signs. The pulse beat sensor had difficulty tracking targets through areas where heavy equipment was operated. On [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] pulse beat sensors were used in conjunction with the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge]] [[weapons detection system]] to track any unauthorized person who had a weapon.<ref name="MSW30" />
